(4/30/2020) Update Log
                                                 
- The game's sprite count went from 40 to 30! Isn't that cool?!?! No? Okay. But hopefully at least the game will load faster than before.
- Werner's first phase has a hitbox now for you guys who wanted to jump over him without hitting his arm.
- 1 Bottlecap design was replaced with one my friend's since he helped me a lot and had to make it to him.
- 4th Phase's ghosts is more organized than before.
- 2nd Phase is fair with a lot more space for the player to move around.
- New picture for Werner's death card.
- New "Invisible" mode
- First phases' wheels are more accurate when they roll, I guess. Right?
- Cuphead controls are improved with it being more accurate to the real game.
- Left credits for the bottlecap designers in the sprite of it. Go check them out.
- Werner's house has a new design. Looks better than the other one at least.
- The firework's bullets has been nerfed because how it would mess with the layers of the game.
- The house background doesn't not break because of the amount of time has passed BUT rather the 4th phases' costume.

- There are more to cover but I don't think they are not that important. Hopefully.
_________________

Keep it up guys.
